verdict.rationale: The evidence describes moq-relay as a server that connects publishers to subscribers, with JWT authentication and automatic broadcast discovery. Nothing documents a server-side administrative API for listing sessions, muting or removing participants, or ending a session. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and broadcast gossip and JWT auth are adjacent features, not session-control endpoints.

support.subject: As a developer, a server-side API lets me list sessions, mute or remove participants, and end a session without a client in the loop
